mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_INTERVIEW_S (company_sq, user_sq, interview_request_txt, interview_status, interview_created_at) VALUES (#{companySq}, #{userSq}, #{interviewRequestTxt}, 'W', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT i.interview_sq, c.company_nm, i.interview_created_at, i.interview_status, i.interview_request_txt FROM TBL_INTERVIEW_S i JOIN TBL_COMPANY_S c ON i.company_sq = c.company_sq WHERE i.user_sq = #{userSq}

SELECT i.interview_sq, c.company_nm, u.user_nm, i.interview_created_at, i.interview_status, i.interview_request_txt FROM TBL_INTERVIEW_S i JOIN TBL_COMPANY_S c ON i.company_sq = c.company_sq JOIN TBL_USER_M u ON i.user_sq = u.user_sq WHERE i.company_sq = ( SELECT company_sq FROM TBL_COMPANY_MEMBER_R WHERE user_sq = #{userSq} AND company_member_leave_dt IS NULL LIMIT 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_INTERVIEW_S SET interview_status = #{interviewStatus}, interview_modified_at = NOW() WHERE interview_sq = #{interviewSq}
